jurisdiction.name: Belize
jurisdiction.constitutionalFoundation: Constitution of Belize (1981). Final appellate court: Caribbean Court of Justice (CCJ).

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the subdivision of land into parcels to be owned individually and the remainder to be owned in common.
primaryActs.summary: Strata regime for Belize. Section 7 establishes the body corporate; section 19 the insurance trust.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the management and disposition of national lands.
primaryActs.summary: Section 19 establishes the Lands Department; section 40 deals with adverse possession; section 100 governs concession.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the registration of title to land in Belize.
primaryActs.summary: Companion volume to the Belize Lands Act. Section 14 establishes the priority of registered interests.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the assessment and collection of land tax.
primaryActs.summary: Establishes the land-tax regime. Section 22 deals with objection and appeal.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the protection of the environment.
primaryActs.summary: Section 6 establishes the Department of the Environment. Indirect relevance for any leasehold environmentally-restricted uses.

leadingCases.caseName: Hopkins Bay Owners v Hopkins Bay Ltd
leadingCases.headnote: Sinking-fund contributions under the Belize Condominium Act s.19 must be deposited in a separate trust account.

remedies.label: Sinking-Fund Segregation Challenge
remedies.description: Action to compel segregation of sinking-fund and operating funds under the Belize Condominium Act s.19.
